messages:
sam: Folks  we need a short plan for customer-facing follow-ups from the postmortem: who drafts what, timelines, and how we handle RCA access requests. Keep it simple.
elaine: I can do the statuspage and the 72h customer digest. Prefer one voice across both. ETA: Thu EOD for statuspage, Fri AM for 72h.
raj: I'll update the remediation tracker and add a 'recurrence hypothesis' section where we note similar incidents in last 90 days. Will also flag any repeating stack traces. ETA: Tue morning.
maria: Legal prefers the following flow: publish a concise public summary + commit to publish RCA within 7 business days; if customer wants full internal RCA, require signed data-sharing addendum. I'll paste approved wording into the postmortem doc.
tess: Support process: customer emails support@ -> auto-ticket -> tag incident-rca -> PSA triages & routes to comms. We need clear owner for each incoming request.
oliver: For account outreach I'll prepare two templates: one for top-tier customers (1:1) and one for volume broadcast. Will wait for statuspage wording so tone matches.
elaine: Draft statuspage text (first pass):
```
Brief summary: Intermittent inference failures affected a portion of requests.
Scope: Some customers experienced delayed or failed responses from 10:03 to 10:47 UTC.
Current status: Mitigated; service restored.
Next steps: Investigation ongoing; a full RCA will be published within 7 business days. Customers may request additional details via support@redwood.ai.
```
raj: Tiny tweaks: replace "portion of requests" -> "subset of customers" and add line "Fallbacks were applied during the window to limit impact."
elaine: Updated. Added fallback sentence and shortened wording.
comms-bot: Draft statuspage posted to #incidents-drafts: https://intranet/redwood/status-drafts/1975313000
maria: Q: Do we want absolute deadline for the RCA or a calendar date? I think "within 7 business days" is clear and consistent with policy.
sam: Stick with 7 business days for now but include a hard escalation if it slips (notify execs and affected accounts).
tess: I'll add a small canned response for support agents explaining the request flow and expected timeline.
raj: Remediation tracker update: added KV-cache patch owner=@raj due=2026-04-09 verification=automated smoke + 2-week regression. Also logged two prior incidents with overlapping stack traces (2026-02-18, 2026-03-12) under recurrence hypothesis.
oliver: Outreach plan: for top 5 accounts - personalized note + offer to walk through RCA. For others - broadcast + link to status page + offer to request details. Drafts by Thu AM.
elaine: Who's doing the 24h internal summary? I'm thinking 24h internal note to customers is noisy; prefer 72h external digest and 24h internal to eng & ops. I can do both public 72h and internal 24h.
sam: Agreed. 24h internal -> eng-runtime & eng-sre for technical detail. 72h external -> customers, short and non-technical. Sam will approve before send.
maria: Legal-approved RCA sharing snippet inserted into postmortem doc. Minor edit: require execution of data-sharing addendum for full logs and internal notes.
comms-bot: Reminder set: statuspage review due in 36 hours.
raj: Suggest automating a weekly recurrence-check job that looks for similar error signatures and latency windows, posts a summary to #eng-runtime and tags incidents for comms. I'll prototype as a spike.
tess: Add support tag in the automation outputs so we can pre-generate template replies when customers ask.
oliver: Once status copy is final, I'll craft the top-tier notes. Want to include an explicit offer for a 30-min call to walk through impacts/remediation?
sam: Yes for top-tier. Include CTA for a call. For others, offer to request a call.
elaine: Action list recap: 1) Final statuspage copy - owner: elaine - due Thu EOD. 2) 24h internal digest - owner: elaine - due Fri AM. 3) 72h public digest - owner: elaine - due Fri AM (sam review). 4) Remediation tracker & recurrence notes - owner: raj - Tue AM. 5) RCA sharing policy text - owner: maria - Wed EOB. 6) Top-5 outreach templates - owner: oliver - Thu AM. 7) Support canned responses/update flow - owner: tess - Thu EOD. 8) Recurrence detector prototype - owner: raj - spike in next sprint.
sam: Please update the remediation tracker with links to the customer-facing docs and ping me when drafts are live. We'll consider this stitch-up closed once all drafts are in staging and outreach templates exist.
raj: Tracker link uploaded: https://drive.redwood/trackers/remediation-1975313000
elaine: Status copy posted to drafts channel and awaiting sam approval.
maria: Legal confirms addendum template available; will attach to RCA-on-request process doc.
comms-bot: Tasks created for owners with due dates.
